about: BLS International Services Limited provides outsourcing and administrative tasks of visa, passport, and consular services to diplomatic missions in the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, Africa, South America, China, and India. It operates in two segments, Rendering of Visa and Other Allied Services; and Digital Services.
